title: Disease entry (example cell): PDR proliferative stage × fibrovascular membrane (human)
stage_note: KB2c developmental axis (Adjudication Q3): Disease cell keys include developmental axis — this cell = adult (all proliferative PDR samples are adult surgical materials; GSE165784/JCI cohort donors are all adults). Developmental-stage samples do not enter adult disease cells (PI Directive Clause 2); if pediatric membrane materials are collected in the future, establish a separate cell rather than merging into this entry.
role: Matrix example cell = 'one cell' rather than project-centric (PI 2026-09-23 ophthalmology general standard)

context.sampling_material: Fibrovascular membranes obtained via vitrectomy combined with membrane peeling (may include internal limiting membrane/epiretinal membrane; GSE165784 sample names PDR-ERM and PDR-FM refer to two surgical terms for the same material, both classified as membranes).
context.treatment_background: Prior laser/anti-VEGF status is not systematically recorded in source data — marked as unrecorded
context.method_scope: scRNA-seq cell suspension (non-nuclear); differs from D001 retina nuclear suspension and D002 ocular surface cell suspension standards

usage_scope: This entry = context consistency check material (non-whitelist): generates only expected/unexpected/contamination flags; prohibited from scoring; labels must not be forcibly changed to identities within the list (Astra T2).

sampling_mismatch_warning.statement: **Sampling material mismatch warning (Core of Astra T2 adjudication)**: The disease site = retina, but the surgical material = fibrovascular membrane. Healthy retina composition baseline (kb/baselines/retina, D001) is [NOT] applicable as a composition threshold for this membrane specimen — membranes are dominated by macrophages/vessels/stroma; near-zero photoreceptors/neural retina classes reflect material nature, not abnormality.
correct_uses_of_retina_baseline: Identity reference (hierarchical judgment of transcriptional similarity between a myeloid cluster and retinal-resident microglia)
Background control from adjacent retina specimens (retina_adjacent cell)
wrong_uses: 'Threshold compliance' acceptance of cell proportions in membrane specimens
Judging Rod/Cone absence as a quality defect (check material first!)
sampling_mismatch_warning.comparable_material_anchor: Primary anchor for comparable materials on this card = GSE165784 (PDR membrane, PMID 35061025) + JCI Insight 2023 independent PDR membrane cohort (PMID 37917183) — same species/material/stage, Astra T2 priority tier 1.

identity_hierarchies.note: Cap for resident/recruited origin determination = transcriptional similarity
Confounded with blood contamination; technical exclusion required first
Continuous with 0009 transition axis; boundary may be unresolved

state_axes.note: Cell cycle signals ≠ angiogenesis conclusion (T7 Step 4: requires identity + proliferation + spatial three-layer evidence)

expected: Macrophages: tissue-resident (SELENOP/FOLR2) + recruited classical monocytes (FCN1/LYZ) + foamy DAM-LAM (GPNMB/TREM2/SPP1) + MHC-II-high APCs + heme-associated stress (HMOX1)
Endothelial: pathological state (PLVAP/NDUFA4L2/HIF1A/ICAM1/VCAM1) + tip/stalk sub-states (DLL4; Grade C extrapolated from TIPCELL_DEV/RAB5IF)
Lymphoid: T cells (CD69 activated), low plasma cell proportion
Proliferating: MKI67+ population present (including MKI67+ microglia, B: PDR_MKI67MG)
Glial: Müller/reactive glial scar components (GFAP↑, B: GLIA_RDG)
Vitreous cell reference: T-cell absolute dominance 91.6% (B: VITREOUS_T) — belongs to PDR__vitreous cell; serves only as material control until independent entry threshold is met

Retina_adjacent cell reference: Microglial state changes in early-moderate DR without massive myeloid influx (B: MG_EARLY_DR/DR_RETINA_SC); Müller reactivity (B: MULLER_REDD1) — belongs to PDR__retina_adjacent cell

signatures.signature_source: markers_membrane_v1.json (canonical/data_driven/pmid_context tri-state provenance) + v2 measured clusters

tissue_resident_mac.locator: Hu2022 (PMID 35061025) Results section; markers_membrane_v1 canonical layer
tissue_resident_mac.limits: Insufficient distinction from homeostatic microglia — SELENOP/FOLR2 also found in perivascular macrophages; source assertion capped at transcriptional similarity

recruited_monocyte.locator: markers_membrane_v1; GSE165784 v2 B5/B9 empirical measurement
recruited_monocyte.limits: High FCN1/LYZ expression confounded with surgical blood contamination — single signature cannot determine 'disease recruitment'; must pair with blood-contamination flag check

foam_DAM_LAM.condition: human PDR membrane; also seen in atherosclerosis LAM (cross-disease)
foam_DAM_LAM.limits: LAM signature not PDR-specific; 'foamy' morphological corroboration requires OCT/histology

heme_stress_mac.locator: GSE165784 v2 sub14 (Grade A empirical measurement)
heme_stress_mac.limits: HMOX1/FTL also driven by dissociation stress and blood presence — rule out technical factors first

MHCII_high_APC.limits: High HLA-DR ≠ dendritic cell identity; single-gene CD74 affected by doublets

patho_endothelial.limits: Insufficient direct evidence for DLL4 tip state in human membranes (Grade C, developmental extrapolation)

pericyte_to_myofibro.limits: Continuous transition spectrum — forced binary classification creates false subtypes (T4); distinguishing 'pericyte-derived' vs 'fibroblast-derived' myofibroblasts requires lineage tracing; transcriptional mixing is indeterminate

reactive_glia.limits: GFAP upregulation non-specific (trauma/stress/development all present); glial components in membrane specimens consistent with expected glial scar

blood_platelet.limits: Platelet transcript reads may originate from megakaryocyte contamination or aggregates — use only as flag, not population

unexpected_flags.action: Flag: Specimen suspected to contain retina proper, report to PI

unexpected_flags.flag: High background of photoreceptor outer segments/lysis fragments (excluding HBA)
unexpected_flags.action: Dissociation stress flag, no disease flag
Suspected sample mixture/annotation error, flag and escalate

unexpected_flags.flag: Identities outside baseline/literature lists (e.g., unexpected lymphoid/extramedullary groups)
unexpected_flags.when: Any cluster that cannot be assigned to resolved concepts
unexpected_flags.note: Off-list identities trigger flags only; must not be forcibly remapped to on-list identities (T2)

unexpected_disposition_queues.out_of_baseline_coverage: Exceeds baseline coverage → record and assess for baseline expansion (backfill W1 mapping)
unexpected_disposition_queues.conflicts_with_literature: Conflicts with existing data → item-by-item citation verification + conflict list reported to PI
unexpected_disposition_queues.technical_suspect: Technical suspicion (doublets/ambient/stress) → enter T1 technical credibility gate re-review queue
unexpected_disposition_queues.candidate_biology: Candidate biological phenomenon → follow T3 disposition chain (confirm observation→exclude technical→identity state→clinical context→independent validation)

contamination_flags.flag: Peripheral blood (classical monocytes FCN1/LYZ/S100A8/9 + platelets PF4/PPBP + neutrophils FCGR3B/CSF3R)
contamination_flags.meaning: Blood influx in surgical specimens — myeloid count interpretation must first deduct blood-derived components (B: GSE165784 v2 B10/sub14 Grade A measured)
Residual liquid-phase components in vitrectomy specimens

minimum_usability_criteria.statement: Minimum viable criteria for entries (Astra T4/P4): ① At least one identity or state evidence directly comparable to the material (species+material+disease condition specified) ② Each signature includes source+evidence conditions ③ No specific evidence, no standalone subtype grid ④ Name merging based only on expression program/lineage/context, not lexical similarity (concept ID mapping table) ⑤ Unestimable interval = valid state, does not block entry establishment.
minimum_usability_criteria.gate_for_new_cell: New grid construction = direct evidence set for this disease×material exists; batch expansion paused (T6), awaiting PRIOR_DIFF control to prove D0 utility

caveats: Tip/stalk endothelial sub-states: limited direct single-cell evidence from human PDR membranes (DLL4+ tip biology mostly derived from development/OIR); marked Grade C — expected presence but no interval defined for proportions.

Composition differences between PDR and RRD membranes lack sufficient independent controls — any 'disease-specific cluster' determination must undergo disease-endpoint comparison before being written (lesson from v2 draft RRD stratification).
PI: PDR annotation itself may be inaccurate → this prior serves as a control and QC flag, not ground truth; when conflicting with data, output a 'prior-vs-data conflict list' for escalation.
v1.1 (this entry): Rearranged per T4 into two levels: identity hierarchy + state axis; old proliferative_DR.json retained as v1 archive (copy, not move).
Concept ID mapping = initial version (17 concepts); naming across different articles is not automatically merged — merge criteria = expression program/lineage/context (T4).
